final: WITH c AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c) SELECT c.event_id, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS quotient FROM c JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY quotient DESC, c.event_id LIMIT 10
